affirmations.text: I can take one slow breath at a time. I do not have to solve everything right now.
It is okay to feel what I feel. I can meet myself with kindness today.
I can return to this moment, gently, without needing to change anything.
My mind does not need to work like anyone else’s for me to be worthy and capable.
I can feel unsure and still take a brave next step.
I am worthy of relationships where care, honesty, and respect can grow.
